note: Changing any value here is a coaching event. Record why in athlete/decision-log.md. Fill in the nulls during setup: from intervals.icu sport settings where possible, otherwise from a recent race with scripts/paces.py.

injury_score.note: The body part scored 0-10 each morning and logged as 'name: N' in intervals.icu wellness comments (icu.py score N). Quality work pauses if any score in the last 7 days is above 3/10 or the weekly average is rising. Leave name null to not track one. 'sports' lists whose quality work it pauses: add "Ride" for an injury riding also aggravates (e.g. a knee).
